phase: prospective extension after the preserved diet audit; exploratory, not external preregistration
admission: Complete explicit numeric model, unambiguous supported semantics and independently solved optimum matching public answer within 1e-6; audit every candidate and retain all rejection reasons. Deduplicate exact numeric models before outcomes.
split: source ID divisible by 5 is development; all other admitted unique sources evaluation
methods_scope: Local algorithm controls, not reproductions of named papers. Controlled text template selects 2 true cost terms plus 1 distractor; no new LLM or human-text validation. Cost-only IO has correct support and is explicitly an oracle-support diagnostic.
positive_floor: Only two declared actual missing unit costs have lower bound1; nuisance lower0. This is an additional positive-integer-price domain prior, not a learned fact and not a change to old results.
prior_center: First minimize unregularized empirical suboptimality on selected3; then choose an empirical near-minimizer closest in L1 to [upper/2,upper/2,0].
subgradient: 100 deterministic cyclic single-history projected subgradient steps, step upper/sqrt(iteration) divided by max(1,gradient norm); return best full-training-loss iterate among initial and every tenth step. Not claimed exact or equivalent to a published implementation.
contexts: Hidden two costs fixed per source; all other positive unit costs multiplied by independent Uniform(0.5,1.5). Relocation demand-stock net balances multiplied by one common Uniform(0.8,1.2) and rounded to integer; positive total slack verified. Tour graph/feasible set fixed. Same contexts shared across every method.
noise_coupling: Within a source/seed/training context use one fixed auxiliary positive objective for both caps; observed decision must be feasible and within true-cost gap cap. Zero cap uses a certified optimum.
primary: K20, gap cap0.10, per-family evaluation source mean over 5 seeds of original-formula normalized regret; never pool families as independent runs.
metric: mean over20 test contexts of max(0,trueCost-oracle)/max(1,abs(oracle)); keep the prior formula
additional_measurement: For EACH predicted optimum, independently minimize and maximize true cost over its optimal face (1e-7 tolerance). Report best/worst and unbounded/uncertified statuses. These are oracle-only diagnostics, not deployable policies. Also per-source min,median,max across5 seeds, means, medians and source-cluster paired bootstrap5000 seed20261021.
failure_policy: Record and retain every scheduled row, solver status, timeout and error; do not impute favorable outcomes or hide failures. No retrospective threshold or hyperparameter selection on test.
old_evidence: Existing diet v2 and audit are immutable historical cohorts and are not re-ranked with new contexts.
